name: heyday-commercial
description: HEYDAY - premium motion graphics commercial (Remotion + SVG)

scripts.music: python3 tools/make_music.py /tmp/heyday-raw.wav && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i /tmp/heyday-raw.wav -af loudnorm=I=-15:TP=-1.2:LRA=11 -ar 48000 public/audio/heyday-score.wav
scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:horizontal
scripts.music:luxury: python3 tools/make_music_luxury.py /tmp/heyday-lux-raw.wav && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i /tmp/heyday-lux-raw.wav -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.2:LRA=11 -ar 48000 public/audio/heyday-luxury.wav
scripts.render:luxury: remotion render src/index.ts HeydayLuxuryVertical out/heyday-luxury-vertical-1080x1920.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k --timeout=90000 && remotion render src/index.ts HeydayLuxuryHorizontal out/heyday-luxury-horizontal-1920x1080.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k --timeout=90000
scripts.music:brands: python3 tools/make_music_brands.py /tmp/heyday-br-raw.wav && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i /tmp/heyday-br-raw.wav -af loudnorm=I=-15:TP=-1.2:LRA=11 -ar 48000 public/audio/heyday-brands.wav
scripts.render:brands: remotion render src/index.ts HeydayBrandsVertical out/heyday-brands-vertical-1080x1920.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k --timeout=90000 && remotion render src/index.ts HeydayBrandsHorizontal out/heyday-brands-horizontal-1920x1080.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k --timeout=90000
